messages:
alex: Heads-up — starting a pilot for tenant-priority routing that picks region by p50 latency + tier penalty. Aim: keep enterprise SLOs while lowering overall egress. Rolling out to EU + US next week. Thoughts?

nisha: Love the direction. Do we have sims on p50 vs p99 impact when we bias by tenant tier? worried about regressions for free-tier p99.

tyler: Ran a sim over last 2w. With a +20ms penalty applied to lower tiers enterprise p50 improves ~15ms, free-tier p99 increases ~30ms at peak. I can dump the graphs.

alex: Can you put those graphs on a dashboard (temp)? Product will want numbers. Also open question: when a region is unhealthy, do we fallback to same-model in remote region (cross-region) or to a cheaper quantized variant locally?

marie: For quality-sensitive tenants prefer remote same-model. For lower tiers fallback to local quantized. We should make that a per-tenant routing policy.

sam: Agree. Also propose a circuit-breaker: if remote region latency > threshold for N secs, switch new requests to local quantized, but keep KV cache warm so we can revert fast.

tyler: Proto policy sketch:
```json
{"priority_penalty_ms": {"enterprise": 0, "standard": 15, "free": 40},
 "fallback_order": ["remote_same_model", "local_quantized"],
 "circuit_break_ms": 300,
 "revert_cooldown_s": 120}
```
Defaults are debatable. Thoughts?

nisha: +1 on structure. Two asks: (1) who owns per-tenant override UI in Console? (2) telemetry — we need per-request routing.decision + routing.reason labels for tracing and cost attribution.

alex: Console ownership: product + eng-platform will split surface. We'll add a per-tenant "routing profile" toggle in preview. Telemetry: add fields routing.decision and routing.reason to request events. Ensure samples go to both tracing and billing pipeline.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: region-routing-service v0.9.1 -> canary eu-west-1 @ 2026-03-21T09:00Z

marie: Dashboard requests: add tiles for "routing fallback rate by tier" and "avg fallback latency" — useful for oncall and product.

sam: I'll add alerts: fallback-rate > 2% sustained > 10m for enterprise -> page. Also add a cost-anomaly watch when remote->local flips cause unexpected egress delta.

alex: Great. @tyler please open an RFC PR with the sim results + policy JSON. @nisha start Console mockups. Sync tomorrow 09:30 PST.
